description: This file defines a custom annotation @Verifies used for linking test cases to specific behaviors in unit testing within the OpenMRS project. It includes package declaration, import statements, and the annotation definition with descriptive comments.

classes.name: Verifies
classes.description: Custom Java annotation used to associate test methods with specific behavior descriptions and the method under test.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the description of what the test does, linked to the '@should' in comments.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Returns the name of the method being tested.
